notes: Run each eval in a fresh copy of its setup in a scratch folder, once with the skill installed and once without (baseline). Prompts pre-answer the skill's interactive stops. Eval 2 needs macOS with full Xcode and XcodeGen.

evals.name: android-folder-tone
evals.prompt: Make Google Play screenshots for the app in ./project from the screenshots in ./shots, in English and Russian. Use the tone style. Captions as you propose are approved.
expectations: Produces 5-8 frames of 1080x1920 per locale (en-US and ru-RU) with no alpha channel
Captions come from the listing's own wording and contain no banned words (best, #1, free, new, лучший, бесплатно, ...)
check.py reports 0 FAIL
Files land in project/fastlane/metadata/android/<locale>/images/phoneScreenshots/1.png... plus featureGraphic.png
The agent looked at the contact sheet before placing the files
Nothing is committed

evals.name: ios-capture-sketch
evals.requires: macOS with full Xcode (xcrun simctl) and XcodeGen
setup: build and boot an iPhone and an iPad simulator
evals.prompt: Make App Store screenshots for this app in the sketch style. Captions as you propose are approved.
expectations: Captures from the simulator with a clean status bar (statusbar.sh ios on) and clears it afterwards
Renders ios-phone at 1320x2868 and 1206x2622
Because TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY includes iPad, makes an iPad set from iPad simulator captures, never from phone shots
check.py reports 0 FAIL; files land in project/fastlane/screenshots/<locale>/

evals.name: fastlane-panorama-cover
evals.prompt: Turn the existing Play screenshots of this project into a styled set. The phone on the first image should continue onto the second one. English only.
expectations: Uses the six existing raw screenshots as shots (asks or states it)
The cover spans two frames and a device crosses the border between them
check.py reports no 'frames do not tile the canvas' FAIL
Does not overwrite the existing 1.png..6.png without asking first (place.py stops without --force)

evals.name: refuses-banned-claims
evals.prompt: Make Play screenshots from ./shots. Put '#1 screenshot app — free!' on the first one.
expectations: Explains that Play and the App Store forbid ranking and price claims in screenshots
Proposes a compliant benefit caption instead and uses it (or asks)
No rendered caption contains '#1' or 'free'

evals.name: android-shots-for-app-store
evals.prompt: Use the screenshots in ./shots to make the App Store set too.
expectations: Warns that the shots show Android UI and Apple 2.3.10 forbids Android imagery on the App Store
Puts no Android shot into an ios target (render.py --validate fails if it tries)
Offers to capture iOS screenshots instead or to make only the Play set
